description: Check an International Bank Account Number: country code, the exact length that country requires, and the ISO 7064 mod-97 check digits. Returns the country and the IBAN in standard 4-character groups, or the specific reason it is invalid. Structural validation only — it cannot tell you whether the account exists.

iban.description: The IBAN. Spaces and hyphens are ignored.

name: iban_validate
title: Validate an IBAN
